name: kaizen-raid-manager
description: Deploy tooling for the two kaizen-krm Cloudflare Workers. The frontend is plain HTML/JS with no real build step, but it has ONE required step: kaizen_raid_manager.html is the actual source file to edit; index.html is what the kaizen-krm Worker's single-page-application asset fallback actually serves to every visitor (any URL that isn't a literal static asset path falls back to index.html, regardless of what kaizen_raid_manager.html says). They are NOT kept in sync automatically - always use `npm run deploy:frontend`, never a bare `wrangler deploy --config pages-wrangler.jsonc`, or edits will sit invisibly undeployed (this happened for an entire session's worth of commits on 2026-09-10 before being caught).
